lounge around: On rainy Sundays, I like to lounge around at home in my pajamas and watch movies all day.
下雨的星期天，我喜歡穿著睡衣在家閒晃，看一整天的電影。
lounge on the sofa: After a long day at work, my dad likes to lounge on the sofa and read the newspaper.
工作了一整天後，我爸爸喜歡癱在沙發上看報紙。
lounge by the pool: During our vacation in Bali, we spent every afternoon lounging by the pool with cold drinks.
在峇里島度假期間，我們每天下午都拿著冷飲在泳池邊閒坐。
lower one's voice: When the baby finally fell asleep, Mom lowered her voice so that she would not wake him up.
當寶寶終於睡著時，媽媽壓低聲音，以免吵醒他。
lower prices: To attract more customers during the holiday, the department store decided to lower prices on all winter clothes.
為了在假期吸引更多顧客，百貨公司決定把所有冬裝降價。
lower one's standards: She refused to lower her standards just to finish the project faster, so she worked late every night.
她不願為了更快完成專案而降低標準，所以每晚都工作到很晚。
lower one's guard: The boxer lowered his guard for just one second, and his opponent knocked him down.
那位拳擊手只放鬆警惕一秒鐘，就被對手擊倒了。
lower oneself: He would never lower himself by cheating on a test, even if it meant getting a bad grade.
他絕不會為了考試作弊而自貶身價，即使那代表會拿到爛成績。
lower the flag: Every afternoon at five, two students lower the flag in front of the school building.
每天下午五點，有兩名學生在校舍前降旗。
lump together: It is unfair to lump together all teenagers as lazy just because a few of them behave badly.
只因少數人表現不好就把所有青少年都說成懶惰、混為一談，是不公平的。
a lump in one's throat: When she watched her son walk across the stage at graduation, she felt a lump in her throat.
看著兒子在畢業典禮上走過舞台時，她感動得哽咽了。
lump sum: When he retired, he received a lump sum from his company instead of a monthly payment.
他退休時從公司領到一筆一次總付的款項，而不是按月領取。
magnify the problem: Shouting at your child will only magnify the problem; it is better to talk calmly with him.
對孩子大吼只會放大問題，最好還是冷靜地和他談談。
magnify the risk: Driving in heavy rain at night can magnify the risk of a serious accident, so please slow down.
夜間在大雨中開車會加大發生嚴重車禍的風險，所以請放慢速度。
magnify an image: The biology teacher used a microscope to magnify an image of a leaf so we could see its cells.
生物老師用顯微鏡放大一片葉子的影像，讓我們能看到它的細胞。
magnify the effect: Adding a little salt can magnify the effect of the sugar and make the dessert taste even sweeter.
加一點鹽能放大糖的效果，讓甜點吃起來更甜。
maintain order: Hundreds of police officers were sent to the stadium to maintain order during the final match.
數百名警察被派到體育場，在決賽期間維持秩序。
maintain a relationship: It is not easy to maintain a relationship when you and your partner live in different countries.
當你和另一半住在不同國家時，要維繫關係並不容易。
maintain one's innocence: Even after ten years in prison, the man continued to maintain his innocence and asked for a new trial.
即使坐了十年牢，那名男子仍堅稱自己無辜，並要求重新審判。
maintain a car: It costs a lot to maintain a car in the city because of parking fees, gas, and repairs.
在城市裡保養一輛車花費很高，因為有停車費、油錢和修理費。
maintain standards: The restaurant checks every dish carefully to maintain standards even when it is very busy.
即使非常忙碌，這家餐廳仍仔細檢查每道菜以維持水準。
maintain contact: After moving to Canada, Lisa still tries to maintain contact with her high school friends through video calls.
搬到加拿大後，莉莎仍努力透過視訊通話和高中朋友保持聯繫。
manifest itself: Stress can manifest itself in many ways, such as headaches, poor sleep, or a bad temper.
壓力會以許多方式顯現出來，例如頭痛、睡不好或脾氣暴躁。
manifest symptoms: Some people who catch the virus never manifest symptoms, so they may spread it without knowing.
有些感染病毒的人從未出現症狀，所以他們可能在不知情的情況下傳播病毒。
manifest one's talent: The young pianist began to manifest her talent at the age of four, playing songs she heard on TV.
那位年輕鋼琴家四歲時就開始展現才華，能彈出她在電視上聽到的歌曲。
a manifest error: The judge said the earlier decision contained a manifest error and ordered the case to be heard again.
法官表示先前的判決有明顯錯誤，並下令重審此案。
manipulate public opinion: Some politicians spread fake news online in order to manipulate public opinion before an election.
有些政客在選舉前在網路上散播假新聞，以操弄輿論。
manipulate data: The scientist was fired after people found out that he had manipulated data to make his results look better.
那位科學家被發現操縱數據讓結果看起來更好之後，就被開除了。
manipulate people: Liars often use flattery and guilt to manipulate people into doing what they want.
說謊的人常用奉承和罪惡感來操控他人，讓別人照他們的意思做事。
manipulate the market: The two companies were fined for working together to manipulate the market and push up oil prices.
那兩家公司因聯手操縱市場、哄抬油價而被罰款。
